definitions.ask: When a plan has terminal-only steps, should `y` still run the non-interactive `--yes` apply?
definitions.why: Keeps the one-`--yes`-proc contract and avoids suspending the TUI for mixed `I` scopes

choices.label: `y` runs `--yes` and skips terminal steps; terminal is the focused primary; skips need attention
`y` hands projects needing a terminal to interactive `sase init`, then plans the rest again
